spell_stamina_open.description: Bind the operator and prepare the disposable spell testing world

spell_stamina_resume.description: Bind the operator again after reconnect without resetting player data

spell_stamina_snapshot.description: Record fixture counters and the current provider state

spell_stamina_clear.description: Disarm the fixture without writing either resource

spell_stamina_throw.description: Invoke a throwing effect through the real wand path and catch only the fixture exception

spell_stamina_status.description: Read the existing integration status without changing gameplay

spell_stamina_a0.description: Prepare a0 and record effective input
